f_mwrknpds1wpe3.sql:
SELECT VERSION_ID AS V, PERIOD AS K,
  SUM(IFF(MODULE = 'revenue', AMOUNT, 0)) AS REV, SUM(IFF(MODULE = 'cogs', AMOUNT, 0)) AS COGS,
  SUM(IFF(MODULE = 'opex', AMOUNT, 0)) AS OPEX, SUM(IFF(MODULE = 'da', AMOUNT, 0)) AS DA,
  COUNT_IF(AMOUNT IS NULL) AS MASKED
FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.CANVAS.SV_PLAN WHERE FISCAL_YEAR = 2026 AND VERSION_ID IN (1,2,3) AND MODULE IN ('revenue','cogs','opex','da') GROUP BY 1, 2;
SELECT VERSION_ID AS V, PERIOD AS K, SUM(SHIPMENTS) AS SHIP FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.CANVAS.SV_OPS WHERE FISCAL_YEAR = 2026 AND VERSION_ID IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY 1, 2;
-- ML band: SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.CANVAS.SV_FORECAST P10/P50/P90 ÷ FC shipments for 2026-10, 2026-11, 2026-12
